verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a commerce platform with an official CLI and developer tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for the CLI, dashboard, or platform. The Klaviyo SMS opt-in item is about merchants' customer marketing subscriptions, not product telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
